reopenLaunch.identityLimit: Visible edition/revision labels and exact Fly action are observed; no independent payload hash or hidden storage state inspected.

measurementLimits: Initial portrait-metrics.json includes descendants of closed details with geometrical boxes and only viewport intersection, so it is not a visibility/size acceptance for all entries. The six named matrix files filter closed details and require center element hit checks. Initial file is preserved.
Only the focused older-edition Fly button is the common fully visible primary control across all six samples; size/focus acceptance does not cover every other control or off-screen action.

Actual CSS sizes are DOM-observed, not inferred from screenshot pixels. One locale/theme pair per six combinations: English Signal Blue and Ukrainian Flight Deck, standard text size. Other theme/locale combinations and large text remain unqualified.

Normal scrolling and keyboard navigation are required in the short content pane; some labels and neighboring controls are clipped outside that pane in screenshots. No claim that an entire card fits at once.
Initial Ukrainian AX reentry had temporarily blank regional labels; settled AX and visible DOM text were captured before action.
negativeEvidence: Preparation documentation lookup browser-capabilities was unavailable; supported viewport documentation was then read. No page mutation from lookup.
Initial unfiltered portrait geometry is retained with corrected visibility interpretation.
Intentional server SIGINT produced actual tool EXIT1 with KeyboardInterrupt; not relabeled EXIT0 or EXIT130.
remaining: All-library controls and full theme/language/text-size matrix
